decisions.reason: Operator training is a low-cost service that builds on the core business, supports machine sales and customer retention, and fits the firm's training capabilities.
A fourth rotary axis is a standard upgrade accessory that complements the milling machines and adds value at little ongoing cost.

Hybrid additive post-processing is far from the core offer and was only mentioned on the website, so it carries some risk, but it fits the firm's future-oriented strategy and is worth continuing for now.
The high-speed CNC milling line is a core product family with several models, launched recently in a growing industry, and is central to the business.
Automatic tool change raises customer productivity, is integral to the machine offer, and was presented prominently on its own page.
